more-itertools-71b76842d32c-5a1d64d1-be4.title: Searching an iterator
more-itertools-71b76842d32c-5a1d64d1-be4.summary: An iterator hands over items one at a time and may not know how many remain. A change asked an iterator for its length, so finding a combination crashed.
more-itertools-71b76842d32c-5a1d64d1-be4.expected: Find the combination at position 12, even when the inputs arrive one item at a time.

more-itertools-111d6deb8080-bf3b6673-5b4.title: Splitting a sequence with the default rule
more-itertools-111d6deb8080-bf3b6673-5b4.summary: Without a custom rule, partitioning should fall back to Python’s true-or-false check. An optimization tried to call the missing rule and crashed.
more-itertools-111d6deb8080-bf3b6673-5b4.expected: Put 0 into the false group and 1 and 2 into the true group.

more-itertools-6a6d1364d8dc-1ea82a71-698.title: Requesting chunks of size zero
more-itertools-6a6d1364d8dc-1ea82a71-698.summary: A change made a request for zero-sized chunks raise an error whenever the input contained items.
more-itertools-6a6d1364d8dc-1ea82a71-698.expected: Return no chunks and leave the input iterator untouched.

more-itertools-2b91cdc175c0-17fd95a0-7f3.title: Reordering items that cannot be sorted together
more-itertools-2b91cdc175c0-17fd95a0-7f3.summary: An algorithm started sorting its input as a first step. It crashed when the list contained values that Python cannot order together.
more-itertools-2b91cdc175c0-17fd95a0-7f3.expected: Return each distinct ordering of the inputs, including mixtures of values like numbers and text.

more-itertools-f9cdcb990dbb-f42daddf-9f0.title: Comparing very large ranges
more-itertools-f9cdcb990dbb-f42daddf-9f0.summary: A change made equality ask Python for the length of an enormous range. The count exceeded the platform’s supported length and raised an overflow error.
more-itertools-f9cdcb990dbb-f42daddf-9f0.expected: Compare the ranges correctly even when their lengths exceed the platform limit.

blinker-64423dfadc9a-0068cb4c-1da91128.title: Recognizing an equal sender ID
blinker-64423dfadc9a-0068cb4c-1da91128.summary: A signal stopped reaching its listener when the sender ID was created separately, even though it had the same integer value.
blinker-64423dfadc9a-0068cb4c-1da91128.expected: Deliver both signals to the receiver subscribed to that integer ID.

babel-bef3a734fbdf-de44e185-e4a8ca4b.title: Keeping the translator’s context
babel-bef3a734fbdf-de44e185-e4a8ca4b.summary: A translator’s note disappeared when the translation call just below it spanned multiple lines. The message reached translators without its context.
babel-bef3a734fbdf-de44e185-e4a8ca4b.expected: Extract the message with its source line and the associated translator comment.

babel-8babd2413b6b-7b00bf9e-365e1118.title: Extracting text alongside byte strings
babel-8babd2413b6b-7b00bf9e-365e1118.summary: The translation extractor started treating byte strings like ordinary text. It crashed before it could return the text around them.
babel-8babd2413b6b-7b00bf9e-365e1118.expected: Keep both text messages and skip the byte string.

attrs-e048efcb3954-3b0378dd-1156ca14.title: Keeping fields from a generator
attrs-e048efcb3954-3b0378dd-1156ca14.summary: A field transformer returned its fields one at a time. A new order check read through them first, leaving no fields when the class was built.
attrs-e048efcb3954-3b0378dd-1156ca14.expected: Build the class with the field named x supplied by the transformer.
